fact: AI chest X-ray interpretation (qXR v3.2) was deployed at James Jenkins Dossen Hospital from March 2023 to January 2025 with the National Leprosy and TB Control Program, and a pre-post comparison of TB notifications reported it identified Xpert-negative and asymptomatic patients.
title: Honored to share our findings at the 4th International Conference on Public Health in Africa (CPHIA) 2025 ... using AI to boost TB case notification in remote Liberia
